teachingQuestion: Which boundaries deserve architecture-specific security review?
focalInsight: Modern deployment families change the location of interfaces and management planes, but identities, secrets, policy enforcement, updates, and recovery remain core trust boundaries.
title: Find boundaries in a distributed service
caption: Review data, identity, management, update, and recovery paths—not just the application workload.

nodes.label: API or ingress
nodes.detail: Authentication, authorization, rate and input controls

altSummary: A distributed-service map shows client, API, workload, data service, management plane, and update supply path as distinct trust boundaries.
textFallback: Review the external client-to-API boundary, API-to-service authorization, service-to-data identity and secret use, management-plane authority over workloads, and image or firmware update provenance. Each path can affect confidentiality, integrity, availability, and recovery differently.
